architecture_authority.decision: A1 freezes canonical result schemas and exact payload authority. A7 remains the sole owner of Gate 0, independent DP, media-verification, and approval behavior.

checks.name: canonical_artifact_envelope
checks.evidence: ArtifactEnvelope resolves every ArtifactKind to one exact canonical payload class. Generic mappings, forged classes, mismatched kinds, mutable aliases, and forged content hashes fail closed.

checks.name: canonical_24000_tick_timebase
checks.evidence: CanonicalTimeline remains fixed at 24000 ticks per second; TickRange is half-open and GenerationSegmentTimeline is local zero-based time.

checks.name: draft_artifact_separation
checks.evidence: Creative drafts remain separate from machine authority. Gate 0, DP review, media evidence, visual verification, owner approval, and release records are distinct immutable result types.

checks.name: no_duplicate_domain_authority
checks.evidence: The mechanical registry assertion proves a bijection between all ArtifactKind values and canonical persistent payload classes. Arbitrary classes cannot self-declare authority.

checks.name: domain_schemas_frozen_for_downstream
checks.evidence: DeterministicGateResult, IndependentDPReviewResult, MediaEvidence, and OwnerApprovalRecord are frozen canonical schemas with bounded enums and cross-field invariants for A2-A10.

checks.name: legacy_read_adapter_only
checks.evidence: The legacy adapter test uses a self-contained historical fixture, proves byte-for-byte read-only behavior, and emits only a canonical BlockingDraft envelope without relying on an untracked CPL run.

review.finding: Invalidated A1 lacked persistent Gate 0 and successful independent-DP result authorities, lacked an explicit owner-approval record, and allowed untyped mappings to bypass ArtifactKind binding.
review.root_cause: ArtifactEnvelope treated ARTIFACT_KIND as optional and A1 modeled review input and revision failure without modeling the successful persistent outputs required by the architecture graph.

considered_options.option: Reuse ReviewPacket, RevisionRequest, or ReleaseGateRecord for missing node results
considered_options.reason: They have different ownership and semantics; reuse would make successful DP review or owner approval untruthful.

considered_options.option: Whitelist generic mapping payloads until A2
considered_options.reason: That is the type-authority escape identified by A2_UPSTREAM_A1_TYPED_STATE_BLOCKER_001.json.

considered_options.option: Freeze explicit A1 result schemas and exact kind-to-class authority, leaving behavior to A7
considered_options.reason: It satisfies the architecture boundary without implementing a later work package.

review.downstream_observation: A2's recovery fixture is correctly rejected because it uses generic mappings with SCRIPT_FACT for E0, S1, B0, and B1 outputs. That fixture remains A2-owned.
review.residual_risk: A2 must bind every persistent state field to the new exact ArtifactKind authority and replace its generic kill-point fixtures. No Shadow, media invocation, owner approval, or production switch was started.

informational_results.name: a2_fail_closed_probe
informational_results.result: 4 failed, 5 passed; all failures are A2's invalid generic SCRIPT_FACT mapping fixture and confirm the A1 authority escape is closed.

informational_results.name: compile_and_patch_check
informational_results.command: python -m compileall -q mode_p_vnext/domain mode_p_vnext/compat; git diff --check
informational_results.result: Domain and compatibility modules compile and no whitespace errors were found.
